newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia calls for bids for 2.0 bln rgt MGS issue. [Corrected 5:00 gmt]
newsitem.headline: Malaysia calls for bids for 2.0 bln rgt MGS issue. [Corrected 5:00 gmt]

text.p: Bank Negara Malaysia on Monday invited principal dealers to bid for the issue of a two billion ringgit Malaysian Government Securities (MGS).
In an announcement, the central bank said the tender opening date for the seven-year issue is on September 27. (Corrects tenure from five years and opening date from September 29).
The MGS will mature on September 30, 2003.
Only principal dealers appointed by the central bank can tender directly for the above issue. Non-principal dealers can tender by submitting bids to the principal dealers.
